description: This file contains functions for interacting with the DatoCMS GraphQL API, including fetching posts, post details, and images, with specific focus on responsive images and post data retrieval.

methods.name: fetchAPI
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the GraphQL API with the provided query and variables, returning the data or throwing an error if the request fails.

methods.name: getPreviewPostBySlug
methods.description: Fetches a post by its slug with preview mode enabled.

methods.name: getAllPostsForHome
methods.description: Fetches a list of posts for the homepage, including images and author info.

methods.name: getPostAndMorePosts
methods.description: Fetches detailed data for a specific post and additional related posts.
